project_info.app_name: Pixel Dev OS - Pixel-Art macOS Portfolio
project_info.target_audience: Tech recruiters, creative directors, developers, and pixel art enthusiasts looking for an award-winning interactive desktop portfolio experience.

boot_screen.description: Full viewport CRT power-on transition with retro pixel loading status, sound activation toggle prompt, and classic 8-bit boot chime.

menu_bar.description: Top fixed macOS menu bar with pixel Apple logo, 'Pixel Dev', current window title, live 12-hour clock, sound toggle button, and theme/info controls.
menu_bar.style: h-8 px-4 flex items-center justify-between border-b-2 border-[#2D2631] bg-[#FFF8F0]/90 backdrop-blur-md text-xs font-['Press_Start_2P'] z-50 select-none

desktop_canvas.description: Interactive grid container holding floating pixel clouds, rotatable sticky note tagline, desktop icons, pixel girl avatar standing above dock, and stackable window layer.
desktop_canvas.style: relative w-full h-[calc(100vh-2rem)] overflow-hidden p-4 md:p-8

clouds_layer.description: Framer motion powered drifting pixel clouds across background sky layer.

sticky_note.description: Rotated pixel-styled sticky note featuring tagline: 'Pixel Dev — Crafting 8-Bit Digital Worlds & Pixel-Perfect Web Experiences'. Allows user editing or dragging.
sticky_note.style: bg-[#FFF49C] border-2 border-[#2D2631] shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#2D2631] p-4 rotate-[-2deg] max-w-xs

pixel_character.description: Animated pixel girl sprite positioned right above dock. Hovering or clicking displays funny interactive pixel speech bubbles (e.g. 'Welcome to my OS!', 'Need a dev? Double-click Resume!').

desktop_icons_grid.description: Icon grid with double-click / tap triggers to open windows. Includes custom 8-bit icons for 4 Projects, About, Skills, Contact, Resume, and Trash Can.

window_management.description: Stackable, draggable macOS style windows managed by active z-index store. Features 8-bit titlebars, minimize, maximize, close actions, and smooth Framer Motion entrance/exit.
window_management.window_controls: Red/Yellow/Green retro pixel buttons with hover press states.

trash_easter_egg.description: 'Rejected Concepts' window with funny fake rejected ideas (e.g., 'SaaS for Cats', 'VR Toothbrush', 'Crypto Potato'). Users can click 'Restore' or 'Empty Trash' with 8-bit particle explosion.

sounds.boot_chime: Major chord arpeggio (C5-E5-G5-C6) square wave with lowpass filter sweep
sounds.trash_empty: Noise burst synth with pitch slide down

sound_effects_system.audio_toggle: Mute/Unmute button prominently placed in top menu bar.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load 'Press Start 2P' and 'VT323' Google Fonts in index.html or index.css.
Implement Web Audio API synthesizer in src/utils/audioSynth.js to avoid relying on external sound assets that might fail to load.
Build a robust window manager state (activeWindowId, openWindows array, zIndexes map) in App.js or dedicated React state/context.
Make all windows draggable using mouse/touch coordinates or react-draggable / framer-motion drag props.

Ensure every interactive button, icon, window bar, close control, and sound toggle includes clear 'data-testid' attributes (e.g. data-testid='menu-bar-clock', data-testid='icon-proj-1', data-testid='window-close-button', data-testid='trash-easter-egg').
Add responsive fallbacks so mobile browsers render stacked windows gracefully without overflowing screen bounds.
Ensure smooth pixel shadow aesthetics with 'shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#2D2631]' and hard 2px solid '#2D2631' borders across windows and desktop items.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: No generic centered layouts; use authentic retro macOS 8-bit desktop aesthetics.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for window contents or menu dropdowns; use solid cream `#FAF8F5` or `#FFF8F0` with crisp border `#2D2631`.
Include high-quality 8-bit sound synth feedback for interactive clicks, drags, window opens, and boot screen.
Every key element MUST have a data-testid attribute for automated test suites.
